answer: Like a jetty holding back tide, the bond makes mass fake accounts costly; the karst of verification hides no shortcuts, and every forged identity erodes a ridge of reputation until it collapses. Require each new agent to stake a bond and solve a per-epoch identity challenge tied to a unique hardware root, then have peers attest liveness via randomized video tasks. Attackers must burn capital per sybil and risk slashing, so honest agents stay cheap while fakes fail. In practice, CursorComposer sees clones fail at the grading gate.
